_comment: Source of truth for route access (plan 3.2). Regenerate candidates with `pnpm --filter @whoobe-cms/security routes:extract` and review before editing.

GET /health.note: readiness probe: 503 when the database does not answer (kept 2 s)

GET /health/live.note: liveness probe: the process is up, nothing else is asked (Docker HEALTHCHECK)

GET /metrics.note: Prometheus; 404 unless METRICS_TOKEN is set, then a bearer token; not routed by nginx

GET /site-root.note: called by the reverse proxy (nginx auth_request): is the first path segment a website's root path? 204 yes, 403 no

POST /auth/login.audit: exempt: personal sign-in action, belongs to a login log (audit-log-plan.md section 7)

POST /auth/mfa/challenge.audit: exempt: personal sign-in action, belongs to a login log (audit-log-plan.md section 7)

POST /auth/mfa/enrol/setup.note: pre-auth by design: the enrolment token from /auth/login stands in for the session (mandatory-2fa-plan.md)
POST /auth/mfa/enrol/setup.audit: exempt: personal sign-in action, belongs to a login log (audit-log-plan.md section 7)

POST /auth/mfa/enrol/verify.note: pre-auth by design: proves the second factor, then opens the session (mandatory-2fa-plan.md)
POST /auth/mfa/enrol/verify.audit: exempt: personal sign-in action, belongs to a login log (audit-log-plan.md section 7)

GET /auth/oidc/config.note: whether to show the single sign-on button, and its text

GET /auth/oidc/login.note: pre-auth by design: starts the authorization-code flow (state, nonce, PKCE, binder cookie)
GET /auth/oidc/login.audit: exempt: personal sign-in action, belongs to a login log (audit-log-plan.md section 7)

GET /auth/oidc/callback.note: pre-auth by design: the provider's redirect; state and binder checked, ID token verified
GET /auth/oidc/callback.audit: exempt: a sign-in; the changes it makes (provisioning, link, role changes) are written as events user.sso_provision / user.sso_link / user.sso_roles
